method: Recomputed sha256 of the new EPUB and screen PDF, encoded as unpadded base64url; both match stage.json. Read epub.diff (10 changed lines) and pdf.diff (63 changed lines) in full. Every changed line is explained by the intended changes: title-page and colophon author/publisher/date, the added 'Start of Content' landmark, the 'Who wrote it' sentence, the new subtitle, the changed build-record hash, and reflow effects (re-wrapped paragraph, blank verso pages that no longer carry a running head, bullet indentation or a slightly moved line/page break, all with identical words). Unzipped the EPUB and read content.opf: dc:title, dc:creator and dc:publisher are as expected, dc:date 2026-09-29, language en-US. Series metadata: belongs-to-collection "Causeway Study Companions" (series, group-position matches the book number). Read title_page.xhtml (shows title, subtitle, Causeway Services as author and again as publisher, date). Looked at the cover PNG and rendered PDF pages 1, 2, 3 and 9 at 60 dpi: cover and title page show the new title, subtitle and Causeway Services byline legibly with nothing clipped or overlapping; the colophon shows Drafted 2026 . 09 . 29; page 9 is ordinary body text with the running head. Trademark check of title, subtitle, cover, title page, running heads, OPF and nav found no named third-party marks in those places (see notes for remaining slug/TOC items). Grepped current texts for '561 Group Study Companions', U+FFFD, template tokens, Markdown markers and straight quotes in added lines: none introduced (hits for '#' are code comments or table headers already in the prior text). The body text is otherwise unchanged from the prior accepted edition (proof digest ni:///sha-256;2LUQRTgUF4dRYje6UsCbUtNNgcaXYgsjbagwm7FxbJM), whose full proof stands for it.

findings.claim: Title page now lists Causeway Services twice, once as author and once as publisher (prior showed the author only). Accurate to the metadata but visually repetitive.
